name: SettingsLayout
tagline: A settings page (gh#1439): a sticky rail (`aside`, default 260px, `--editorial-settings-layout-aside-inset` from the top) beside the panels, gap 64px. A theme hides the rail on narrow screens with `--editorial-settings-layout-aside-display: none` and one track.
usage: DO put a short note and one link in the rail, never controls.
